import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyWeilDivisor

/-!
# Global sections of a sheaf supported at finitely many closed points

The germ map identifies global sections with the product of the nonzero
stalks. This is the sheaf-theoretic input to the degree of an effective
divisor in Kleiman's relative divisor construction, Section 3, `sb:ediv`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace TopCat.Sheaf

/-- Global sections of an abelian sheaf supported at finitely many closed
points are determined by, and realize, arbitrary stalk values there. -/
theorem globalSectionsGerm_bijective_of_finite_support
    {X : TopCat.{u}} (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X)
    (Z : Set X) (hZ : Z.Finite)
    (hclosed : ∀ x ∈ Z, IsClosed ({x} : Set X))
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ Z, Subsingleton (F.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    Function.Bijective (fun s : F.obj.obj (op ⊤) =>
      fun x : Z => F.presheaf.germ ⊤ x.val (by trivial) s) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro s t hst
    apply TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext F ⊤ s t
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxZ : x ∈ Z
    · exact congrFun hst ⟨x, hxZ⟩
    · letI := hzero x hxZ
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  · intro t
    have hc (Y : Set X) (hY : Y ⊆ Z) : IsClosed Y := by
      have h := (hZ.subset hY).isClosed_biUnion
        (fun x hx => hclosed x (hY hx))
      simpa only [Set.biUnion_of_singleton] using h
    have hlocal (x : X) : ∃ (U : Opens X) (_ : x ∈ U)
        (s : F.obj.obj (op U)),
        ∀ z : Z, ∀ hz : z.val ∈ U, F.presheaf.germ U z.val hz s = t z := by
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Z
      · let V : Opens X := ⟨(Z \ {x})ᶜ, (hc _ Set.sdiff_subset).isOpen_compl⟩
        have hxV : x ∈ V := by simp [V]
        obtain ⟨U, hUV, hxU, s, hs⟩ := F.presheaf.exists_le_germ_eq (t ⟨x, hx⟩) hxV
        refine ⟨U, hxU, s, ?_⟩
        intro z hz
        have hzx : z.val = x := by
          by_contra hne
          exact hUV hz ⟨z.property, hne⟩
        have he : z = ⟨x, hx⟩ := Subtype.ext hzx
        subst z
        exact hs
      · let U : Opens X := ⟨Zᶜ, (hc Z (fun _ h => h)).isOpen_compl⟩
        refine ⟨U, hx, 0, ?_⟩
        intro z hz
        exact False.elim (hz z.property)
    choose U hx s hs using hlocal
    have hcov : (⊤ : Opens X) ≤ iSup U := by
      intro x _
      exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x, hx x⟩
    have hcompat : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible F.obj U s := by
      intro x y
      apply TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext F
      intro z hz
      rw [F.presheaf.germ_res_apply, F.presheaf.germ_res_apply]
      by_cases hzZ : z ∈ Z
      · exact (hs x ⟨z, hzZ⟩ hz.1).trans (hs y ⟨z, hzZ⟩ hz.2).symm
      · letI := hzero z hzZ
        exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    obtain ⟨a, ha, -⟩ := F.existsUnique_gluing' U ⊤
      (fun _ => homOfLE le_top) hcov s hcompat
    refine ⟨a, funext fun z => ?_⟩
    have h := congrArg (F.presheaf.germ (U z.val) z.val (hx z.val)) (ha z.val)
    rw [F.presheaf.germ_res_apply] at h
    exact h.trans (hs z.val z (hx z.val))

end TopCat.Sheaf
